sections.heading: Carried by more than one source

items.title: Introducing tsrs: A port of TypeScript to Rust
items.blurb: Cloudflare is collaborating on tsrs, a Rust port of TypeScript that is up to 8x faster and uses 70% less memory.

items.title: Debunking "Faster than Rust": Malicious Benchmarks in Tov
items.blurb: I have debunked (some of the) benchmarks of this new and suspicious "Tov" programming language.

items.title: Announcing rustup 1.29.2
items.blurb: The rustup team is happy to announce the release of rustup version 1.29.2. Rustup is the recommended tool to install Rust , a programming language that empowers everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

items.title: Announcing Rust 1.99.1
items.blurb: The Rust team has published a new point release of Rust, 1.99.1. Rust is a programming language that is empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

items.title: Cloudflare Reclaims 100 TB of RAM by Optimizing Consistent Hashing
items.blurb: Cloudflare recently documented how it reduced the memory footprint of its internal load-balancing service by more than 100 TB by optimizing the Rust implementation of consistent hashing in pingora-ketama.

items.title: Demoting i686 Windows targets to std-only
items.blurb: With Rust 1.100.0, the following changes to 32-bit Windows targets will happen: i686-pc-windows-msvc Tier 1 with host tools target will be demoted to Tier 1 without host tools.
